says: The plant check reads every plant record of every run row a pull request adds, with no date, order or dedupe, and refuses each record on an owned file that no changed law there claims, so a later record can never supersede an earlier, wrong one for the same law: the only way out is to edit the earlier row before it lands.
proof: At c5184b7e0, .github/ci/plant-check.ts:382 keeps every added field/runs/*.json (status A) and :383 flatMaps all their plants into one list; :279 builds the owned set from every head and untouched file on the package's it, and the loop at :281-:289 pushes an unclaimed refusal at :287 for each record whose file is owned and that no held law matches by file, title and plant, whatever other records say. On fabrikalfa/law-options-0580, field/runs/2026-11-16-law-options-0580-slice2-tests.json line 17 names next/packages/libfabrika/src/ledger/LedgerTurnReads.test.ts (on the package's it, its line 7) for the law T1041 L7 ledger, which appears 0 times in that file and once in LedgerTurnEndTest.ts; a correct reprinted record naming LedgerTurnEndTest.ts clears that law's not_recorded side but leaves this unclaimed refusal.
cost: Every wrong record in a run row forces an edit of that row before it lands, against the field rule that rows are written once; after a row lands on main, a wrong record in it cannot be fixed at all while its law's file is owned and changed again.
